lessons.correction: Continue heavy production and technology, strengthen ground forces, and increase economy while maintaining expansion.
lessons.mistake: Focusing solely on economy and technology, neglecting army production, leaving you vulnerable to early timing attacks.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when opponent's first combat units are scouted or when transitioning to midgame.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting army production while teching
lessons.when: Early game, own ground macro with heavy production and tech, opponent posture unknown but heavy economy and tech.
lessons.why: A heavy tech/economy opening benefits from uninterrupted development; maintaining a strong ground core provides safety against early pressure.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening ground forces, maintain economy and production, and keep tech development on track.
lessons.mistake: Over-extending your army without proper scouting, leaving you vulnerable to warp prism harass.
lessons.recheck: Re-check if opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid overextending without scouting
lessons.when: Early-midgame, own ground macro with Siege Tanks and Marines, opponent ground posture with Warp Prism.
lessons.why: A ground-based composition with Siege Tanks provides strong defensive and offensive capability against a ground-oriented Protoss.

lessons.correction: Increase air presence and technology, strengthen air forces, and continue expanding.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting your ground army while focusing on air, leaving you vulnerable to remaining ground forces.
lessons.recheck: Re-check when opponent's composition is fully known.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting ground army when transitioning to air
lessons.when: Late-midgame, own ground macro with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Battlecruisers, opponent ground posture with Void Rays.
lessons.why: Void Rays are strong against ground, so transitioning to air with Battlecruisers provides a counter.
